scripts.render: remotion render src/index.tsx Promo out/ledgerquarry-promo-vertical.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --pixel-format yuv420p
scripts.render:v2: remotion render src/index.tsx PromoV2 out/ledgerquarry-promo-v2-raw.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --pixel-format yuv420p
scripts.finish:v2: ffmpeg -y -i out/ledgerquarry-promo-v2-raw.mp4 -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=7 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -vf scale=out_range=tv,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset slow -movflags +faststart out/LedgerQuarry-promo-v2-20s.mp4
scripts.finish: ffmpeg -y -i out/ledgerquarry-promo-vertical.mp4 -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=7 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -vf scale=out_range=tv,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset slow -movflags +faststart out/LedgerQuarry-promo-20s.mp4
